title: The Rain Immortal Realm
summary: At the shattered gate platforms of the Immortal Realm, Wang Lin sets a restriction and a recovery formation on one platform as other cultivators gather, among them Chi Hu of the Giant Demon Clan, Sun Tai of the Corpse Yin Sect and Zhou Yi, and he scares off a challenger with his Thunder Toad. The Rain Cauldron carries him into the Rain Immortal Realm, a ruin of spirit-stone palaces whose immortal energy has almost gone, and a monument names the palace of the Rain Immortal King given to Immortal Tianhua. Hong Wen of the Daluo Sword Sect claims a hidden store of immortal energy his sect has milked for 3,000 years, but the Thunder Toad, at peak mid Soul Formation, outmatches him and Wang Lin seals him in the Red Gold Bell to refine his soul. Taking his teleportation slip to the sect's 37 fragments, Wang Lin collects immortal energy and high-grade spirit stones, then reaches a ruined fragment where an illusion shows immortals feasting until a giant palm smashes the Immortal Realm in one blow.
events: Wang Lin claims and fortifies a gate platform; Chi Hu, Sun Tai, Zhou Yi and Zhan Bai gather
His Thunder Toad drives off a challenger
He enters the ruined Rain Immortal Realm
Hong Wen of the Daluo Sword Sect fights him over a store of immortal energy
Wang Lin seals Hong Wen in the Red Gold Bell and takes his teleport slip
He gathers immortal energy and spirit stones
An illusion shows the Immortal Realm destroyed by a single palm
cultivation: Chi Hu: Soul Formation. Sun Tai and Zhou Yi: mid Soul Transformation. Zhan Bai and Hong Wen: early Soul Formation. The Thunder Toad: peak mid Soul Formation. Wang Lin appears to be early Soul Formation.
